title: 3D plastic mace
description: This party's resources have changed the shape of the hammer to appear three-dimensional and plastic-like.
body:
🛠️ Plastic 3D Hammer (Mace Resource Pack)
A clean and stylish resource pack for Minecraft that transforms the Mace into a unique 3D plastic hammer with a modern look ✨
🔹 What does this pack do?
This pack replaces the default Mace model with a fully redesigned 3D hammer, featuring smooth details and a soft purple color style for a fresh visual experience.
🔹 Features:
High-quality 3D model (not just a texture)
Clean and polished design
Lightweight and performance-friendly
Looks great with animation mods (like Hold My Items)
🔹 How to use: Simply enable the resource pack in-game, and the Mace will instantly change its appearance.
🔹 Compatibility:
Supports latest versions
Works with Fabric and vanilla
Compatible with most resource packs![Here is the shape of the hammer](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/261cb6e8a7cee685677c8bade061f27734f4a8e8.png)
